_meta.note: Frozen output of build_nav.py, the sidecar implementation deleted in the same commit that added this file. Keyed by sha256 of (stdin, NAV_SCOPE, NAV_DEFAULTS). There is deliberately no generator left in the tree: a diff against these bytes means the Go port changed, and the fix is to revert the port, never to re-bless the golden.
